questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'Dispatch the confidential case records to the registry immediately.'

options.text: Let the confidential case records be dispatched to the registry immediately.
The confidential case records were dispatched to the registry immediately.
Let the confidential case records dispatched to the registry immediately.
You are requested to dispatch the confidential case records to the registry immediately.

questions.explanation: Active sentence direct command/instruction hai jisme direct object 'the confidential case records' hai. Standard imperative formula 'Let + Object + be + V3' lagta hai: 'Let the confidential case records be dispatched...' (A). Option (B) Simple Past assertive bana deta hai. Option (C) mein auxiliary 'be' missing hai. Option (D) tone ko polite request bana deta hai jo original command se match nahi karti.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Let + Object + be + V3.

questions.question:
Choose the most appropriate passive conversion:
'Please grant the defendant seven days to submit the written statement.'

options.text: Let the defendant be granted seven days to submit the written statement please.
You are requested to grant the defendant seven days to submit the written statement.
The defendant must have been granted seven days to submit the written statement.
You are ordered to grant the defendant seven days to submit the written statement.

questions.explanation: Sentence 'Please' se shuru ho raha hai, jo polite judicial request ko represent karta hai. Formal requests ke liye situational passive 'You are requested to + V1' lagta hai aur 'Please' drop ho jata hai: 'You are requested to grant...' (B). Option (A) redundant 'please' retain karta hai. Option (C) modal-perfect deduction bana deta hai. Option (D) polite request ko coercive order bana deta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Polite Requests = You are requested to + V1 (drop 'please').

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'Do not circulate the unapproved draft notifications.'

options.text: Let the unapproved draft notifications be not circulated.
Let the unapproved draft notifications not be circulated.
You are forbidden not to circulate the unapproved draft notifications.
The unapproved draft notifications should not circulate.

questions.explanation: Negative imperatives ka standard formula: 'Let + Object + not + be + V3'. Negative particle 'not' auxiliary 'be' se pehle aana mandatory hai: 'not be circulated' (B). Option (A) mein 'be not circulated' incorrect word order hai. Option (C) mein 'forbidden' ke sath 'not' double negative blunder hai. Option (D) mein 'be' missing hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Negative Imperatives = Let + Object + not + be + V3.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Select the most suitable passive construction for:
'Protect the endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary.'

options.text: Let the endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary be protected.
The endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary should be protected.
You are commanded to protect the endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary.
The endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary can protect.

questions.explanation: Sentence moral obligation aur ecological duty ko express kar raha hai. Welfare advice aur duty ke liye 'Object + should be + V3' examination standard ke hisaab se sabse accurate form hoti hai: 'The endangered wildlife species in the sanctuary should be protected' (B). Option (A) cold command sound karta hai. Option (C) military command add karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Advice & Obligation = Object + should be + V3.
questions.provenanceSource: RPSC LDC / High Court Exam Pattern

questions.question:
Convert the sentence into Passive Voice:
'The system administrator can configure the new firewall rules.'

options.text: The new firewall rules could be configured by the system administrator.
The new firewall rules can be configured by the system administrator.
The new firewall rules can configured by the system administrator.
The new firewall rules must be configured by the system administrator.

questions.explanation: Active sentence simple modal 'can' ke sath hai. Passive formula: 'Object + can + be + V3 + by-agent'. Modal auxiliary 'can' freeze rahegi aur 'can be configured' (B) banegi. Option (A) Narration rule lagakar modal ko 'could' karta hai. Option (C) mein auxiliary 'be' missing hai. Option (D) modal ko 'must' karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Simple Modal Passive = Object + Modal + be + V3.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'Every citizen ought to obey the environmental regulations.'

options.text: The environmental regulations ought to be obeyed by every citizen.
The environmental regulations ought be obeyed by every citizen.
The environmental regulations should have been obeyed by every citizen.
The environmental regulations ought to have obeyed by every citizen.

questions.explanation: Modal 'ought to' ka passive structure hota hai: 'Object + ought to be + V3 + by-agent'. Isliye 'The environmental regulations ought to be obeyed...' (A) bilkul sahi hai. Option (B) mein 'to' drop kar diya gaya jo error hai ('ought' ke sath 'to' aana mandatory hai). Option (C) modal ko 'should have been' kar deta hai. Option (D) mein 'been' missing hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Ought to Passive = Object + ought to be + V3 + by-agent.

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'The maintenance team could have averted the major network blackout.'

options.text: The major network blackout could be averted by the maintenance team.
The major network blackout could have been averted by the maintenance team.
The major network blackout could have averted by the maintenance team.
The major network blackout could has been averted by the maintenance team.

questions.explanation: Active sentence Modal Perfect ('could have averted') mein hai. Passive formula: 'Object + Modal + have been + V3 + (by + Subject)'. Isliye 'could have been averted by the maintenance team' (B) sahi answer hai. Option (A) simple modal kar deta hai. Option (C) mein 'been' missing hai. Option (D) modal ke baad 'has' lagata hai jo impossible error hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: Modal Perfect Passive = Object + Modal + have been + V3.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'The junior clerk should not have disclosed the sealed tender bids.'

options.text: The sealed tender bids should have not been disclosed by the junior clerk.
The sealed tender bids should not have been disclosed by the junior clerk.
The sealed tender bids should not be disclosed by the junior clerk.
The sealed tender bids should not have disclosed by the junior clerk.

questions.explanation: Modal perfect negative sentence mein 'not' hamesha pehli modal auxiliary ('should') ke theek baad lagta hai: 'should not have been + V3' (B). Option (A) mein 'should have not been' galat word order hai. Option (C) simple modal kar deta hai. Option (D) mein 'been' missing hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Negative Modal Perfect = Modal + not + have been + V3.
questions.provenanceSource: High Court System Assistant Exam Exemplar

questions.question:
Convert the interrogative sentence into Passive Voice:
'Must the candidates submit the self-attested affidavits today?'

options.text: Must the self-attested affidavits be submitted by the candidates today?
Must be the self-attested affidavits submitted by the candidates today?
Should the self-attested affidavits be submitted by the candidates today?
The self-attested affidavits must be submitted by the candidates today?

questions.explanation: Yes/No modal question ka passive formula: 'Modal + Object + be + V3 + by-agent?'. Modal auxiliary 'Must' sentence ke start mein inverted rahegi: 'Must the self-attested affidavits be submitted...?' (A). Option (B) mein 'Must be' dono helping verbs subject se pehle aa gaye jo incorrect syntax hai. Option (C) modal ko 'Should' bana deta hai. Option (D) question inverted word order todkar assertive bana deta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Interrogative Modal Passive = Modal + Object + be + V3?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Convert the sentence into Passive Voice:
'The anti-corruption bureau looked into the allegations of forgery.'

options.text: The allegations of forgery were looked by the anti-corruption bureau.
The allegations of forgery were looked into by the anti-corruption bureau.
The allegations of forgery had been looked into by the anti-corruption bureau.
The allegations of forgery was looked into by the anti-corruption bureau.

questions.explanation: 'Look into' prepositional verb hai aur tense Simple Past ('looked into') hai. Naya subject plural ('The allegations') hone ki wajah se auxiliary 'were' aayegi aur preposition 'into' verb ke sath retain rahegi: 'were looked into by...' (B). Option (A) preposition 'into' drop karta hai. Option (C) Past Perfect kar deta hai. Option (D) plural subject 'allegations' ke sath singular auxiliary 'was' lagakar concord error karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Prepositional Verb = were + looked into + by-agent.
questions.provenanceSource: RPSC Grade II / High Court Paper

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'The judicial committee did not approve of his reckless conduct.'

options.text: His reckless conduct was not approved by the judicial committee.
His reckless conduct was not approved of by the judicial committee.
His reckless conduct had not been approved of by the judicial committee.
His reckless conduct is not approved of by the judicial committee.

questions.explanation: 'Approve of' prepositional verb hai jiska Simple Past negative 'did not approve of' hai. Passive Voice mein preposition 'of' verb ke V3 form ke sath chipki rahegi aur agent marker 'by' ke sath aayegi: 'was not approved of by the judicial committee' (B). Option (A) preposition 'of' ko drop kar deta hai. Option (C) Past Perfect aur Option (D) Simple Present kar deta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Prepositional Verb Retention = was not approved OF by.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Convert into Passive Voice:
'The employee union called off the indefinite demonstration.'

options.text: The indefinite demonstration was called by the employee union.
The indefinite demonstration was called off by the employee union.
The indefinite demonstration had been called off by the employee union.
The indefinite demonstration was being called off by the employee union.

questions.explanation: 'Call off' transitive phrasal verb hai (meaning: cancel karna). Simple Past tense hone ke karan auxiliary 'was' aayegi aur particle 'off' verb ke sath intact rahega: 'was called off by...' (B). Option (A) particle 'off' drop kar deta hai jisse meaning cancel ki jagah call karne ka nikalta hai. Option (C) Past Perfect aur Option (D) Past Continuous kar deta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Phrasal Verb = was + V3 + particle + by-agent.

questions.question:
Which of the following represents the correct passive transformation when the Direct Object (Thing) is promoted to subject?
Active: 'The district judge awarded the petitioner substantial damages.'

options.text: Substantial damages were awarded the petitioner by the district judge.
Substantial damages were awarded to the petitioner by the district judge.
The petitioner was awarded substantial damages by the district judge.
Substantial damages was awarded to the petitioner by the district judge.

questions.explanation: Active sentence mein do objects hain: Indirect Object = 'the petitioner' aur Direct Object = 'substantial damages'. Direct Object ko subject banate waqt Indirect Object se pehle preposition 'to' lagana mandatory hota hai: 'Substantial damages were awarded TO the petitioner by the district judge' (B). Option (A) preposition 'to' ko drop kar deta hai jo classic fatal error hai. Option (C) Indirect Object ko promote karta hai (jabki question mein Direct Object ko promote karne ko kaha gaya hai). Option (D) plural subject 'damages' ke sath singular auxiliary 'was' lagata hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: DO Promoted = DO + were + awarded TO + IO + by-agent.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence containing a grammatical error in Voice:
'(A) The genuine grievances of the candidates / (B) were listened by the registrar / (C) with utmost patience / (D) No error'

options.text: (A) The genuine grievances of the candidates
(B) were listened by the registrar
(C) with utmost patience
(D) No error

questions.explanation: Part (B) mein error hai. Verb 'listen' jab kisi object ko complement banati hai, toh uske sath preposition 'to' aana compulsory hota hai ('listen to someone/something'). Passive Voice mein preposition 'to' retain rehni chahiye: 'were listened TO by the registrar'. 'listened by' likhna preposition dropping error hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Preposition Retention = were listened TO by.

questions.question: Which of the following passive sentences is GRAMMATICALLY INCORRECT?

options.text: You are forbidden to enter the high-security server chamber.
You are forbidden not to enter the high-security server chamber.
You are instructed not to enter the high-security server chamber.
Let the high-security server chamber not be entered.

questions.explanation: Sentence (B) grammatically incorrect hai kyunki verb 'forbidden' khud ek inherently negative verb hai (meaning: prohibited / mana kiya gaya). Iske sath dobara 'not' lagana ('forbidden not to enter') fatal double negative blunder hai. Sentence (A) correct hai ('forbidden to enter'). Sentence (C) correct hai ('instructed not to enter'). Sentence (D) standard 'Let' negative passive hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: Forbidden Polarity Rule = forbidden to + V1 (never use 'not' after forbidden).
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L05
